cases.name: leaked_policy_far_epoch
cases.description: At epoch 1, a policy signed by the leaked customer key version 1 claims epoch 1000 and the largest version.

cases.name: leaked_command_far_epoch_and_seq
cases.description: At epoch 1, a command signed by the leaked key claims epoch 1000 and the largest seq; the epoch comparison rejects it before its seq is looked at, and the next ordinary command is accepted.

cases.name: after_recovery_leaked_key_revoked
cases.description: At epoch 1 the leaked policy and command are rejected for their epoch. After the recovery key set (2, 1), which lists the leaked key in revoked_kids, they come again; then the assignment, a policy and an ordinary command of epoch 2 are accepted.

cases.name: after_recovery_leaked_key_dropped
cases.description: At epoch 1 the leaked policy and command are rejected for their epoch. After the recovery key set (2, 1), which has the leaked key neither in keys nor in revoked_kids, they come again; then the assignment, a policy and an ordinary command of epoch 2 are accepted.

cases.name: after_recovery_leaked_key_kept
cases.description: At epoch 1 the leaked policy and command are rejected for their epoch. After the recovery key set (2, 1), which still has the leaked key in keys, they come again; then the assignment, a policy and an ordinary command of epoch 2 are accepted.

cases.name: seq_floor_raised_then_recovery
cases.description: At epoch 1 the leaked key signs a command with the largest seq that passes every check, raising the sequence floor; an ordinary command is then stale. The recovery key set (2, 1) restarts the floor, and an ordinary command of epoch 2 with a new command_id is accepted.
